title: loop router
description: Sends the message along the link with rule loop a number of times (the link's expression), each round with the message the round before produced, and headers loop.index and loop.size; then along the other link, if any. As an action the rest of the flow is run once per round.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the number of rounds, when the loop link does not set one

expression.title: Number of rounds
expression.description: Number of rounds, when the loop link has no expression; default 1

copy.title: Copy
copy.description: Give every round a copy of the message as it entered, instead of the message the round before produced
